## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: a9cd522224f24e1bdd4ce953efea840830e5fc56

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation.** The fix touches five files, all centered on calls to `ConfigElement.getPath(...)` for `GRAPH_CONFIG_KEYS` / `SCAN_JOB_CONFIG_KEYS`, changing them from the 1-arg form to the 2-arg form with `includeRoot=true`. I inspected `ConfigElement.getPath` to understand the semantics: without `includeRoot=true`, the generated dotted path stops walking up the namespace tree as soon as it reaches a namespace whose parent is the root — effectively omitting the top-level root segment (`"titanmr"`) from the path. I then traced the read side of this configuration flow (`ModifiableHadoopConfiguration.prefixView`, used by `getTitanGraphConf()`/`getScanJobConf()`), and found that at `b860ac0ad^` (the commit right before the fix) it already calls `ConfigElement.getPath(prefixRoot, true)` — i.e., the reader includes the root segment. Meanwhile the writer-side call sites fixed by `b860ac0ad` (`MapReduceIndexJobs`, `MapReduceIndexManagement`, `CassandraHadoopScanRunner`, `HBaseHadoopScanRunner`, and the `CassandraScanJobIT` test) were still calling the 1-arg `getPath(...)` (root excluded). That read/write mismatch is exactly the bug: values written by the mapreduce/index-management code are never found under the prefix the reader actually looks for.

**(2) Root cause commit.** `git log -p` on `ModifiableHadoopConfiguration.java` shows the `includeRoot` overload of `ConfigElement.getPath` and its use in `prefixView` were introduced together in commit `a9cd522224f24e1bdd4ce953efea840830e5fc56`. That same commit also touched `MapReduceIndexJobs.java`, `MapReduceIndexManagement.java`, `CassandraHadoopScanRunner.java`, `HBaseHadoopScanRunner.java`, and `CassandraScanJobIT.java` — but only to rename `TITAN_INPUT_CONFIG_KEYS` → `GRAPH_CONFIG_KEYS` (part of a broader namespace restructuring in `TitanHadoopConfiguration.java`), not to add the new `, true` argument. So in one commit, the reader was switched to "include root" while the writers were left on the old "exclude root" behavior — introducing the inconsistency that `b860ac0ad` later corrects by aligning all the writer call sites with `includeRoot=true`.

**(3) Supporting evidence.**
- `git show b860ac0ad^:.../ModifiableHadoopConfiguration.java` confirms the reader (`prefixView`) already used `getPath(prefixRoot, true)` before the fix commit.
- `git show a9cd52222 -- ModifiableHadoopConfiguration.java` shows this exact line (`ConfigElement.getPath(prefixRoot) + "."` → `ConfigElement.getPath(prefixRoot, true) + "."`) being changed in that commit, simultaneously with the `ConfigElement.getPath` overload being added.
- The same commit's diff on `MapReduceIndexJobs.java`/`MapReduceIndexManagement.java`/`*ScanRunner.java`/`CassandraScanJobIT.java` only renames the referenced constant, leaving the `getPath(...)` calls as the old 1-arg (root-excluded) form — the exact lines `b860ac0ad` later patches to add `, true`.
- No commit between `a9cd52222` and `b860ac0ad` touches any of these files (verified via `git show --stat` on each intervening commit), so the inconsistency persisted unchanged from `a9cd52222` until it was fixed.

I'm highly confident in this attribution: the fix is a direct, mechanical correction of an inconsistency introduced atomically in `a9cd52222`, and no other commit plausibly fits given the intervening history is untouched on these files.
